answer: Splitting into 3 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded vault account and a separate escrow deposit for each, as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the violet binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The delta explorer shows the whole merge tree. Honest users pay that once, farms 10 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
